text:
Zara (partnerships): Heads-up: partner wants a combined HW + marketplace launch for the Snowflake connector in two weeks. Need compliance checklist + marketplace tile copy.
Leo (eng): Do we need a separate hardware validation artifact? we have perf numbers for DGX and A10.
Marta (pm): Partner asks for a short "supported hardware" table and a note on expected throughput at medium load. keep it 2 bullets.
Vik (field-eng): Quick tech plan: 1) run 4-hour soak on DGX; 2) capture p50/p95 and ingest throughput; 3) produce a one-page compatibility note. I can run soak Fri 02:00 UTC.
Zara (partnerships): Partner via Partner Bot: "We can provide lab access for validation and logo assets by Thu." :white_check_mark:
Leo (eng): ops note: add `--concurrency 6` to ingest script and cap embedding batch size to 256. small code snippet in runbook.
Marta (pm): Legal flagged publishing direct throughput numbers; suggestion: publish ranges and test config instead. I'll draft copy accordingly.
Vik (field-eng): I'll prepare the compatibility note with: hardware tested, model quantization used, sample config, and a short troubleshooting FAQ.
Zara (partnerships): Actions: (1) Vik -> soak Fri + upload CSVs; (2) Leo -> sample runbook snippet + badges list; (3) Marta -> draft marketplace blurb and legal-safe performance ranges. Sync Thu 9:30 PT.
Partner Bot: Reminder set: DGX soak Fri 02:00 UTC.
